title: Drain Myth: Chemical Cleaners Cure All
description: A common misconception in plumbing is that pouring harsh chemical drain cleaners down a slow pipe is a universal fix for clogs. In reality, these corrosive formulas can generate extreme heat, damaging PVC pipes and destroying rubber seals. Furthermore, if the chemical fails to clear the obstruction, it leaves standing caustic water in the pipe, creating a severe safety hazard for any plumber called in to snake or service the line. Professional practice relies on mechanical clearing methods, such as augers or hydro-jetting, to safely remove the root cause of a blockage without compromising the integrity of the drainage system.

Drain Myth: Chemical Cleaners Cure All

A common misconception in plumbing is that pouring harsh chemical drain cleaners down a slow pipe is a universal fix for clogs. In reality, these corrosive formulas can generate extreme heat, damaging PVC pipes and destroying rubber seals. Furthermore, if the chemical fails to clear the obstruction, it leaves standing caustic water in the pipe, creating a severe safety hazard for any plumber called in to snake or service the line. Professional practice relies on mechanical clearing methods, such as augers or hydro-jetting, to safely remove the root cause of a blockage without compromising the integrity of the drainage system.
